title: 拉莫斯 · 叶子小车
description: 绿色龟甲的拉莫斯推着装满落叶的小木车，圆眼睛笑眯眯。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Rammus keeps his compact armadillo-like body, green plated shell, cream-yellow belly, stout little legs, and recognizable rows of shell spikes. Round the spikes into friendly crayon shapes, with bright curious eyes and small paws clearly separated from the shell. Retain this champion's distinctive silhouette and recognizable accessories, softened into friendly rounded shapes with opaque clothing wherever appropriate.
art_direction.scene: He stands upright just enough to push a low wooden toy cart filled with autumn leaves. One oversized maple leaf rests on his shell, and a simple sandy garden path curves behind him with plenty of warm paper visible. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: leaf green, butter yellow, terracotta, warm brown, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
